messages:
Evan: Heads up — Nimbus is ready to sign. They want the MSA + PO in place this week. Procurement flagged DPA residency and an indemnity redline. Can legal + salesops shuffle this? :eyes:

Tara: Got it. PO amount confirmed? Do they need POC credits applied to first invoice?

Evan: PO is for $125k, POC credits of $5k to be applied to invoice #1. They asked for Net 60 initially but AE pushed Net 30. PO snippet I uploaded to the portal:

```json
{ "po_number": "NIM-98765", "total": "$125000", "po_credits": "$5000", "payment_terms": "Net 30" }
```

Maria: Can you drop the specific redlines? I can't open the marked-up MSA — link gave 403.

Evan: Uploaded 2 files: "MSA_nimbus_redline.docx" and "DPA_addendum_nimbus.pdf" to the shared folder. Key ask: 1) remove broad indemnity paragraph (sec 9) 2) require EU data be stored in eu-1 region 3) KMS customer-managed key option requested.

Kishore: Procurement here — our vendor portal requires the signed MSA AND a PO with billing contact and tax ID. Also need the vendor W-9 for US billing. Is W-9 uploaded?

Tara: Not yet. Evan, can you get the W-9 and vendor billing contact? Also accounting needs invoice routing: invoices@redwood-invoice.com or do they want their AP mailbox?

Evan: Nimbus will use ap@nimbus-corp.com. Sending W-9 now.

Jade: Finance — Net 30 is okay but we need the PO to reference the specific pricing schedule (Schedule A). If MSA redlines change pricing warranty, we need to loop PM.

Maria: On the indemnity — we can offer mutual indemnity limited to direct damages and carve out third-party IP with a capped liability of X x fees. Suggest language replace:

"Each party shall indemnify the other for third-party claims arising out of a breach..." -> "Each party's indemnity liability shall be limited to direct damages and capped at the total fees paid in preceding 12 months."

Evan: Nimbus counters: they want no cap for IP claims. Sales asks for a compromise: carve out willful infringement and keep cap for other claims.

Kishore: On DPA / data residency: Procurement requires EU processing stay in eu-1 or they will require SCCs + an additional SOC2 attestation. Which option is faster for them to accept?

Evan: They said prefer eu-1 region and customer-managed KMS. If we can't promise CMK in the private deployment, they want to delay go-live.

Maria: CMK is available for private/private-cloud packages only. For Hosted tier, we can offer tenant-isolated keys via our HSM but not customer vault. I'll mark options in the doc and propose a fallback: strict SCC + contractual DPA controls.

Tara: For signature routing: Nimbus requires CFO signature and Procurement signature (two-stage). Can we route: Legal -> SalesOps -> CFO -> Procurement? Docu will need correct signer emails. Please confirm order.

Evan: Yes, route order: Maria (Legal) signs countersign, then SalesOps (Tara) approves commercial, then Nimbus CFO signs, then procurement finalizes. Nimbus wants e-sign (DocuSign) and an audit trail.

Tara: I'll create the envelope. Quick check: which MSA version are we sending (redline accepted parts)? We should include a summary of concessions for exec review.

Maria: I approve the mutual indemnity compromise and data residency fallback. Add the CMK caveat. Also add: breach notification within 72 hours and monthly security report for first 6 months.

Kishore: Procurement will accept electronic PO if it includes PO number and billing contact. Also need vendor payment terms on PO to match invoice terms. I'll hold for signed MSA + W-9.

Evan: Uploading final MSA (redlines applied per Maria notes) and the PO with updated billing info now: https://drive.redwood/nimbus/closing-pack

DocuBot: Envelope created by Tara (SalesOps). Routing: Maria -> Tara -> Nimbus CFO (cfo@nimbus-corp.com) -> Nimbus Procurement (ap@nimbus-corp.com). Subject: Redwood MSA + PO (NIM-98765). Tracking ID: env_20241101_9832 :white_check_mark:

Evan: Thanks all. If Nimbus signs today, we can start provisioning private key option next week. Please flag any last blockers asap.
